subject: history
concept: Applying Age of Exploration knowledge to a real-world scenario using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student plans an imagined exploration voyage, choosing a purpose, route, and needed supplies/tools
exercise.pictorial: Student illustrates their planned voyage on a map
exercise.abstract: Student explains their voyage plan's reasoning in a short written response

assessment.mastery_threshold: plan reflects accurate reasoning about historical exploration motivations and tools
misconception_flags: plan includes tools or motivations inconsistent with the actual historical era studied

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
